Episode 6
Keshav spots Prema on a magazine cover and learns that it’s her birthday. Meanwhile, Prema is furious at the editor as the magazine has got her birth date wrong. This confusion means that Keshav arrives at Prema’s house to celebrate her birthday while forgetting his wife’s birthday in the process. What happens next, watch this episode to find out.
